ORDER Date : 09-09-2022
Heard Mr. S. Banik, learned counsel for the writ petitioner.

Also heard Mr. K.
Gogoi, learned Govt. Advocate, Assam who submits that instructions as called for vide order dated 02-09-2022 passed by this Court are still awaited.
Mr. A. Borpujari, learned counsel has appeared on behalf of respondent Nos. 2 to 4 by filing vakalatnama and prays for 02 weeks time to obtain instruction.
Prayer allowed.
Let this matter be listed again after 02 weeks.
At this stage Mr. Banik submits that unless an interim order is passed the writ petition may become infructuous.

Taking note of the submission of the learned counsel for the parties as well as the facts and circumstance of the case, it is hereby provided that till the next date the tender in question shall not be finalized.
